findings.message: Removing 'defer resp.Body.Close()' leaks the response body on error paths: if os.Create fails or io.Copy returns an error, Fetch returns without closing resp.Body (the explicit Close only runs on the success path). This can exhaust connections/file descriptors under repeated failures.
findings.suggestion: Restore 'defer resp.Body.Close()' immediately after the Get error check and remove the manual close before return; or ensure resp.Body.Close() is called on every exit path (e.g. via defer).
